en.hubeali:
From him, from Yahya Bin Isa, from the one who informed him, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The best of the foods is the rice, and we<sup>asws</sup> cure our<sup>asws</sup> sick ones with it’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Yahya ibn ‘Isa from those who narrated to him who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Rice is very good and we use it as medicine to cure our people from illness.’”
